title: [Exploring for integrative signals guiding intracellular circadian clock synchronization: discovery of the BMAL1-ISR phenomenon].
authors: Tamaru, Teruya; Kawamura, Genki; Naito, Atsuhiko; Ozawa, Takeaki
journal: Nihon yakurigaku zasshi. Folia pharmacologica Japonica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BMAL1蛋白磷酸化与核定位驱动的昼夜节律同步化，虽涉及蛋白修饰与核转运，但未聚焦蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点或三维结构建模，且方法以实验和数学模拟为主，缺乏AI或分子动力学模拟，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: Cell-autonomous circadian clocks are essential for organisms to adapt to daily environmental changes and optimize physiological timing. However, the common initial signaling events shared by diverse synchronizing cues-such as light, temperature, and drugs-remain elusive. Here, we investigated the relationship between clock synchronization and subcellular localization dynamics of core clock proteins, BMAL1 and CLOCK, in NIH-3T3 fibroblasts. We identified an immediate, synchronized nuclear accumulation of BMAL1 immediately following various clock-resetting treatments, termed the "Immediate Synchronization Response" (ISR). This was accompanied by nuclear CLOCK accumulation. ISR phenomenon was also observed in other rodent clock cell models like C6 glioma cells. Mechanistically, phosphorylation of BMAL1 at Ser90 by Casein Kinase 2 (CK2) increased immediately upon stimulation. Consistent with the role of this phosphorylation in promoting nuclear BMAL1, pharmacological CK2 inhibition partially suppressed both the acute increase in Per2 expression and the clock phase shifts. Furthermore, mathematical simulation analysis supported the notion that increased phosphorylation levels of BMAL1 and its subsequent nuclear localization could serve as a driving force for phase shifts in the circadian oscillatory system. In conclusion, our findings suggest that BMAL1-ISR acts as a key integrative "switching signal" linking diverse synchronization cues to molecular clock oscillations.
abstract_zh: 细胞自主的昼夜节律钟对于生物体适应日常环境变化和优化生理时序至关重要。然而，多种同步信号（如光、温度和药物）所共有的初始信号事件仍不明确。在此，我们研究了NIH-3T3成纤维细胞中时钟同步与核心时钟蛋白BMAL1和CLOCK的亚细胞定位动态之间的关系。我们识别出一种在多种时钟重置处理之后立即发生的、同步的BMAL1核积累现象，称为“即时同步反应”（Immediate Synchronization Response, ISR）。这一现象伴随有CLOCK的核积累。ISR现象也在其他啮齿动物时钟细胞模型（如C6胶质瘤细胞）中观察到。机制上，由酪蛋白激酶2（Casein Kinase 2, CK2）介导的BMAL1在Ser90位点的磷酸化在刺激后立即增加。与该磷酸化促进BMAL1核定位的作用一致，药理学抑制CK2部分抑制了Per2表达的急性增加以及时钟相位偏移。此外，数学模拟分析支持了BMAL1磷酸化水平增加及其随后核定位可作为昼夜节律振荡系统中相位偏移驱动力的观点。总之，我们的发现表明，BMAL1-ISR作为一个关键的整合“开关信号”，将多样化的同步信号与分子时钟振荡联系起来。
